description: Template advisories for jadserve.postrelease.com/trk.gif with Nativo event-pixel fields. Checks blank generated values and the completeness of the published native response shape when ntv_fl is present. The VAST variant can omit ntv_fl. Generated values remain opaque.

params.name: ntv_at
params.description: The published event pixel carries a generated ntv_at value. Preserve the value from the original tag.
params.fix_hint: Restore the original ntv_at value from the Nativo event pixel.

params.name: ntv_a
params.description: The published event pixel carries an opaque ntv_a value.
params.fix_hint: Restore the original ntv_a value from the Nativo event pixel.

params.name: ntv_fl
params.description: The published native response includes an opaque ntv_fl value. Observed VAST URLs can omit the field.
params.fix_hint: If the original Nativo event pixel includes ntv_fl, preserve its value.

params.name: ntv_ht
params.description: The published event pixel carries an opaque ntv_ht value.
params.fix_hint: Restore the original ntv_ht value from the Nativo event pixel.

params.name: ord
params.description: The published native response includes ord with both positive and negative examples. Accept other supplied values and macros.

rules.message: The published native event pixel includes ntv_at, ntv_a, ntv_ht and ord alongside ntv_fl.
rules.fix_hint: Compare the URL with the original Nativo ad-serving response.
